author: Photius of Constantinople
title: Bibliotheca (Myriobiblon)

sources.source: Freese, J.H. The Library of Photius, Vol. I. London: SPCK, 1920. Project Gutenberg eBook #79139.
sources.imprint: London: Society for Promoting Christian Knowledge; New York: The Macmillan Company
sources.notes: Only Vol. I (codices 1-165) published. Vol. II-V never issued. Used as PD English reference for densify; new English must be from Greek.

sources.source: Tertullian.org mirror of Freese translation, codices 1-165.
sources.notes: Same Freese text, HTML format with Greek terms in entity encoding.

sources.source: Photius, Bibliotheca. Ed. Immanuel Bekker, Berlin 1824. Also PG 103 (Schott Latin). Greek text reconstructed from multiple PD witnesses.
sources.notes: Greek copy-text for translation. Bekker 1824 is the standard critical edition. Schott's Latin in PG 103 serves as version check. No critical edition since 1824.

pd_english_note: Freese 1920 Vol. I (codices 1-165) is PD English. New English for densify must be from Greek, not copied from Freese.
